name: G K P Printing & Packaging  Ltd
about:
Incorporated in 1994, G.K.P Printing & Packaging Ltd manufactures Corrugated Boxes and trades Kraft Paper, Duplex Paper 
 and Low-Destiny Plastic Rolls (LD Rolls)[1]
keyPoints:
Product Profile:[1]
Cardboard Boxes, Colored Corrugated 
Boxes, Corrugated Packaging Boxes,  Corrugated Paper Boxes, Customised Corrugated Boxes, Corrugated Box with Partition, White Corrugated Boxes, Display Boxes, Mailer Boxes, Labels, Stickers, Tags, Inserts and Leaflets,  Mono Carton, etc.

pros: Stock is trading at 0.70 times its book value
cons: The company has delivered a poor sales growth of 2.53% over past five years.
Company has a low return on equity of 0.07% over last 3 years.
Company has high debtors of 181 days.
